notes: Node payload record shape (glb_emit.rs): GlbNodePayload { name: String, color: SrgbColor (sRGB RGBA 0..1), mesh: Option<GlbMesh { positions: Vec<f32> (xyz), indices: Vec<u32> }>, parent: Option<usize> (must precede its child in insertion order), matrix: [f32;16] column-major }. Emission entry: emit_glb(&[GlbNodePayload]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Refusal>, a hand-rolled writer over serde_json (12-byte header + JSON chunk 0x4E4F534A + BIN chunk 0x004E4942, 4-byte aligned; in-repo precedent examples/generate_ball_bearing.rs; no new dependency, serde_json already a truck123d dep). sRGB to linear conversion call site: the per-channel srgb_to_linear(f64) in glb_emit.rs applied when the material's pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor is built inside emit_glb (piecewise 0.04045 cutoff, 12.92 lower branch, 1.055 power upper branch); alpha passes through unconverted; metallicFactor 1.0 / roughnessFactor 0.5 fixed defaults. API note / deviation: assembly_emit.rs gains exactly one new pub fn, assembly_occurrence_labels(root, parts), which walks the landed assembly graph (same build/walk as emit_step_assembly) and returns the frozen #root.N occurrence labels (position+1) that feed the GlbNodePayload.name fields; the GLB emission writes payload names verbatim as GLB node names, so the corpus convention is reproduced from assembly insertion order by the marshal path (the emit layer itself is naming-agnostic and names round-trip verbatim). Parent hierarchy rides as node children arrays; payload order == GLB node index order. No new Refusal arms (all validation refuses Refusal::Empty). New files follow H-1 (no unwrap/expect/panic/index in non-test code; test file propagates via Result, never unwraps).
